zscore_threshold.title: Z-score threshold
zscore_threshold.description: Minimum z-score used to determine if an epitope is detected

max_overlap.title: Maximum Peptide Overlap
max_overlap.description: Maximum allowed overlap between detected peptides when summarizing results per-organism

schema.title: Sample Table
schema.description: One row per FASTQ file, each a replicate of a sample. Mark at least two rows as beads_only controls. All FASTQ files must be in the same S3 bucket.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Replicates with the same sample name are combined in the per-organism summary
sample.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, periods, hyphens and underscores

sample_name.title: Replicate Name
sample_name.description: Leave blank to use the FASTQ file name

control_status.title: Control Status
control_status.description: beads_only for a negative control, library for an unselected library sample, or blank for an empirical sample

fastq_filepath.title: FASTQ
fastq_filepath.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read
